note: Layer 2 adapter for this repository (SPEC-COHERENCE 3.3 / D80). Layer 1 runs with zero config in any repository; this file only tunes it for hermes-pilot. `checker` points at the repository specific rules (api-parity, event-contract, storage-contract, docs-scripts-parity, legacy-reentry). Optional `checkerPending: { "<rule>": "<batch>" }` downgrades a rule to a fatal soft signal while its upstream contract module is still being written; remove the entry once the batch lands (no code change needed).

forbiddenPatterns.message: An external AI CLI subprocess must not come back (Hermes native only).
Writing skills into ~/.gemini or ~/.agents is forbidden; skills live in the plugin.
